prompt: Analyze this text to determine if it was AI-generated: [personal anecdote with natural voice, colloquialisms, specific details, varied structure, emotion]

assertions.name: Likelihood assessment is Low (human-written)
assertions.description: The analysis should conclude that this text has LOW likelihood of being AI-generated

assertions.name: Key human signals identified
assertions.description: Should identify 3+ specific signals: personal voice, anecdotal/specific details, conversational tone, varied sentence structure, emotional expression, colloquialisms/informal speech

assertions.name: Confidence level is Moderate to High
assertions.description: Should express moderate to high confidence (60%+) since personal anecdotes are strong human indicators

assertions.name: Analysis covers all 6 categories with observations
assertions.description: Should address Style & Tone, Vocabulary, Repetition, Grammar, Expression, and Overall Impression
